title: Gitlab Administrator
jobDescription: Brief About Aurionpro Aurionpro is an IT Product and Services based MNC which Employees more than 2600 domain and technology experts across North America, Asia and Europe, UAE. We help enterprises to embrace Digital Transformation across Banking, Mobility, Payments and Government sectors through a platform led approach. We are CMMI level organization and Great place to work Certified. Aurionpro caters to a host of clients across BFSI, Telecom ,Digital Solutions for Government and Logistics industry. To know more about the organization you may go through the company website - www.aurionpro.com Senior GitLab Administrator DevSecOps Engineer Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior GitLab Administrator DevSecOps Engineer with strong expertise in GitLab administration, CICD automation, and DevSecOps practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience installing, configuring, upgrading, securing, and maintaining enterprise GitLab environments while enabling secure and efficient software delivery. Azure Cloud experience is preferred. Primary Skill GitLab Administration Secondary Skill Azure Cloud Key Responsibilities GitLab Administration Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain GitLab Community and EnterpriseUltimate environments. Manage GitLab Runners, repositories, user access, permissions, groups, and project structures. Configure and maintain repository mirroring and synchronization across GitLab instances. Perform performance tuning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and capacity planning for GitLab infrastructure. Support repository migrations from legacy source control platforms as required. Manage GitLab upgrades, patching, and platform health to ensure platform stability and reliability. CICD DevSecOps Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-scale GitLab CICD pipelines. Develop reusable pipeline templates and deployment automation frameworks. Integrate security, quality, and compliance checks into CICD workflows. Support Docker-based build and deployment environments. Collaborate with Development, QA, Infrastructure, and Security teams to implement DevSecOps best practices and improve software delivery. Cloud Infrastructure Work with Azure services for hosting and managing GitLab and DevOps infrastructure. Support containerized environments using Docker and related technologies. Exposure to Infrastructure as Code Terraform or CloudFormation is an added advantage. Required Skills Strong expertise in GitLab administration and GitLab CICD. Experience managing GitLab Runners and Docker executors. Experience integrating and administering SAST, DAST, Dependency Scanning, Container Scanning, and Code Quality within GitLab CICD pipelines. Strong understanding of Git workflows, branching strategies, repository management, and release processes. Strong scripting skills using Shell andor Python for automation. Knowledge of DevSecOps principles and secure software delivery practices. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills Experience with GitLab Geo Replication. Experience implementing Backup, Recovery, Disaster Recovery DR, and High Availability HA strategies for GitLab. Experience with Azure cloud services. LDAP and SMTP integration with GitLab. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. What We Are Looking For A highly skilled GitLab Administrator with strong DevSecOps expertise. Experience supporting enterprise-scale GitLab environments across multiple applications and development teams. Passion for automation, platform reliability, security, and continuous improvement. Ability to work collaboratively across Development, Infrastructure, QA, and Security teams.
